cohort_definition.logged_target: The normalized mention text matches a target entry in the video_reference_log.txt for the same frame.
cohort_definition.other: All benchmark examples not matched to a logged target entry.
cohort_definition.normalization: Remove angle-bracket annotation markers, lowercase, collapse whitespace, and remove a terminal occurrence suffix such as _00.
cohort_definition.note: Matched examples can exceed unique log entries when the same normalized target text occurs more than once in a frame.

interpretation.primary: Logged target mentions form a difficulty-enriched subset: their R@1 is 50.8% versus 75.3% for other mentions, and the gap remains within both explicit and implicit mentions.
interpretation.conditional_error: Conditional on an exact-ID error, logged targets have modestly larger center distance, while any-overlap and IoU>=0.5 rates are similar to other errors.
caveats: Reference logs record video consultation or timestamp/reference verification, not a prospectively designed annotator-confusion label.
Logging practices may differ across annotators, videos, languages, and topics.
Target matching is normalized text matching and may merge repeated occurrences with the same surface form in one frame.
This analysis is post hoc and should be presented as supporting evidence rather than a primary benchmark claim.
